definitions: plural of work in its countable senses
A factory or factories, or a similar collection(s) of industrial facilities.

blocks.text: "It Works" is a song written by Mickey Cates and Mark Alan Springer, and recorded by American country music group Alabama. It was released in January 1996 as the third single from the album In Pictures. The song reached number 19 on the Billboard Hot Country Singles & Tracks chart.
